        String dna = sc.next();
        int result = 0;
        
        if (dna.isEmpty()) {
            System.out.println(0);
            return;
        }
        
        char[] chars = dna.toCharArray();
        int i = 0;
        
        while (i < chars.length) {
            char c = chars[i];
            int j = i;
            while (j < chars.length && chars[j] == c) {
                j++;
            }
            
            int run = j - i;
            if (run % 2 == 0) {
                result++;
            }
            
            i = j;
        }
        
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
